facts.text: On 2004-01-19, John Kerry won the Iowa caucuses with 38% of the vote, staging a dramatic last-minute comeback.

On 2008-01-23, John Kerry accused opponents of using "Swiftboat" smear tactics against Barack Obama, in an apparent criticism of the Clintons.

events.summary: A group of more than 200 of John Kerry's former Vietnam comrades, calling itself Swift Boat Veterans for Truth, holds a press conference accusing him of betraying fellow servicemen and exaggerating his injuries, as his campaign attributes the attacks to Republican activists.

A row over John Kerry's Vietnam combat medals escalated after a resurfaced 1971 television interview in which he claimed he threw his medals away, prompting the White House to question his credibility while Kerry insisted he only threw away his ribbons.
John Kerry secures the Democratic nomination for president, prompting intensified attacks on his anti-war activities during the Vietnam era.
John Kerry was criticized by the Republican-backed Swift Boat Veterans for Truth for having spoken publicly in 1971 about American atrocities in Vietnam.
John Kerry won the Iowa caucus, gaining momentum ahead of the New Hampshire primary in his campaign for the Democratic presidential nomination.
Article contrasts Republican reactions to Donald Trump’s remarks about John McCain with their responses to 2004 attacks on John Kerry’s Vietnam war record.
President George W. Bush called for an end to ads by independent groups attacking either candidate amid controversy over anti-John Kerry ads by Swift Boat Veterans for Truth.

A group of Vietnam veterans called Swift Boat Veterans for Truth is questioning John Kerry's military record, claiming in ads and a bestselling book that he is unfit for command, while editorials criticize President Bush for not calling off his surrogates.

John Kerry called on the White House to condemn criticism of his Vietnam War record and released a television commercial promoting his version of events, after reporters found that critic Larry Thurlow's own Bronze Star citation backed up Kerry's account of being under enemy fire.

An advertisement featuring veterans, including Larry Thurlow, was broadcast in swing states alleging that John Kerry won his medals by lies and subterfuge, part of a coordinated campaign that also included a forthcoming book, "Unfit for Command."
John Kerry accused opponents of using "Swiftboat" smear tactics against Barack Obama, in an intervention that appeared mainly aimed at the Clintons.

FBI files released under freedom of information legislation show the FBI spied on John Kerry for more than a year in the early 1970s after he appeared before the Senate foreign relations committee in 1971 as a leader of Vietnam Veterans Against the War.
US Secretary of State John Kerry said any agreement at the Paris climate summit would “definitively not going to be a treaty” and would not include legally binding reduction targets like Kyoto.
US Secretary of State John Kerry said governments trying to reach a climate agreement in Paris face a tough fight in the 72 hours remaining to reach a deal.
John Kerry rejected James Hansen's claim that the Paris climate talks were a "fraud," defending the resulting accord as a signal for a global transition to renewable energy.

US Secretary of State John Kerry signaled that the outgoing Obama administration is preparing to fight to keep the US in the Paris climate agreement and urged the incoming Trump administration to consider climate science before making irrevocable choices.
US Secretary of State John Kerry vows to put climate change "front and center" of American diplomatic efforts ahead of the UN climate summit.

Secretary of State John Kerry announced a "unique co-operative effort" with China on climate change, saying the two countries had completed implementation plans for five initiatives and agreed to exchange information and discuss policies ahead of next year's global climate change agreement.
John Kerry is confirmed as secretary of state, installing a climate advocate in the position.
Secretary of State John Kerry announced that the US would double its aid to $861 million for countries on the frontline of climate change during UN climate talks in Paris.
Secretary of State John Kerry promises climate change will top the agenda of the US-China Strategic and Economic Dialogue.

John Kerry, chair of the Senate foreign relations committee, said the US has given up hope of reaching a global climate change treaty at Copenhagen and is working toward a binding political agreement with fixed reductions, to be enshrined in international law by the end of 2010.
Senator John Kerry promised that the US Congress would pass major climate and energy legislation if a successful deal was reached at the Copenhagen climate talks.
US Secretary of State John Kerry was present at the final Paris climate talks, where a global climate agreement was adopted.
